# Xenoi Biotech

> Bioinformatics analysis, reproducible research workflows, and practical training for the next generation of scientists.

Xenoi Biotech Pvt. Ltd. (Punjab, India) provides research-focused bioinformatics data analysis and hands-on computational biology education. We turn complex next-generation sequencing (NGS) data into reproducible, publication-ready genomic insights.

## Pages & Structure

- [Home](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/): Overview of bioinformatics services, genomic pipelines, multi-omics capabilities, and training programs.
- [Services](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/services.html): Overview of pipeline development (Nextflow/Snakemake), data interpretation, and research consulting.
- [Genomics Services](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/genomics.html): Specialized NGS analysis including Whole-Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole-Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted panels, and de novo genome assembly.
- [Workshops](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/workshops.html): Hands-on bioinformatics bootcamps including Python for Bioinformatics, NGS Data Analysis, and RNA-Seq Analysis.
- [Career Navigator](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/career-navigator.html): A structured career guidance programme designed specifically for life science students across nine career pathways.
- [Internships](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/internships.html): Practical training in bioinformatics, computational biology and genomics across Foundation, Applied and Capstone tiers.
- [Collaboration](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/collaboration.html): Collaboration with colleges to provide career guidance, training and internship opportunities tailored to life science students.
- [Team & Contact](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/team.html): Meet the team behind Xenoi Biotech, led by our Director and Lead Bioinformatician.
- [Project Quote](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/quote.html): Submit project inquiries or training requirements for customized proposals.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/privacy.html): Privacy terms, transparent data practices, and zero-tracking policy.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/terms.html): Terms of service, research-use-only disclaimers, and legal guidelines.
